question: Should OpenClaw add a read-only recursive/depth mode to `subagents list`, and should it be owned by the existing subagents tool or deferred into broader session-chain/tree APIs?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix creates stable public tool/slash semantics and must preserve the existing subagent control boundary.

options.title: Add Read-Only Depth Listing
options.body: Add `depth` or `recursive` to the existing subagents list surface with parent/depth metadata while leaving mutation scope unchanged.

options.title: Fold Into Chain/Tree Work
options.body: Keep this open but make the recursive view depend on the broader session-chain or active-agent tree design first.

options.title: Decline Hierarchy Expansion
options.body: Document the current direct-child behavior and supported push-based completion workflow instead of expanding depth-0 visibility.

recommendation.title: Add Read-Only Depth Listing
recommendation.body: Add `depth` or `recursive` to the existing subagents list surface with parent/depth metadata while leaving mutation scope unchanged.
